desc.en: Replace both motor limits. Stay with the blind and keep its path clear. Close the Tuiss app, pause Flows, then save both endpoints using the step and save buttons.
desc.nl: Replace both motor limits. Stay with the blind and keep its path clear. Close the Tuiss app, pause Flows, then save both endpoints using the step and save buttons.

desc.en: Move one small step up during limit setup. Direction follows Reverse direction. Start Set limits first.
desc.nl: Move one small step up during limit setup. Direction follows Reverse direction. Start Set limits first.

desc.en: Move one small step down during limit setup. Direction follows Reverse direction. Start Set limits first.
desc.nl: Move one small step down during limit setup. Direction follows Reverse direction. Start Set limits first.

desc.en: Save the current endpoint during setup. Read the Set limits description for the current step. Both endpoints must be saved in sequence.
desc.nl: Save the current endpoint during setup. Read the Set limits description for the current step. Both endpoints must be saved in sequence.

desc.en: Stop the motor and end setup. This does not restore the old limits. If interrupted, configure both endpoints again.
desc.nl: Stop the motor and end setup. This does not restore the old limits. If interrupted, configure both endpoints again.
